name: Apply Door Finish Coat
intent: One coat of finish per module invocation. Spray and brush tasks both present, gated by application_method so only the relevant one fires. Scenarios needing two coats list this module twice with MOD_INTERSTAGE_DOOR between them.
doctrine: Spray (10 sides/hr) is 2.5x faster than brush (4 sides/hr) for door finish. Brush is the labor-intensive premium method that produces brush marks the customer often wants on traditional residential doors. Spray produces a glass-smooth laydown with no brush marks. Source spec uses identical rates for coat 1 and coat 2 — no rates_by_coat needed. Door type complexity comes from the door_type modifier in the existing engine's DOOR_TYPE_MODIFIERS table; for Phase 1b minimal validation we test with uniform door types so the modifier is constant.
